Removed the can_return_columns_from_insert skip gates on existing

performed and that returning field overrides are respected.

expected_issues.title: pre_save() called with add=False during INSERT
expected_issues.description:
On INSERT, field.pre_save() is called with add=False, so auto_now_add fields are not populated at that point (and are None for code such as upload_to callables that depend on them).

This block runs in the insert branch of _save_table(); pre_save(instance, add) must receive add=True there. With add=False, DateField/DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True).pre_save() returns the current attribute (None) instead of setting now(), and because pre_save() is the hook that populates the attribute, later consumers (FileField upload_to callables, other fields' pre_save) observe None.
